items.titleZh: F1史上十大最接近的完赛差距：拉塞尔巴库守住维斯塔潘末段冲击
items.summaryZh: 在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，拉塞尔从发车到冲线一路领跑夺冠，但维斯塔潘末段的追赶使完赛差距极小，这场较量跻身F1历史上最接近的完赛之列。

items.originalTitle: F1's top 10 closest finishes after George Russell holds off Max Verstappen's late Baku challenge
items.summaryEn: George Russell claimed a lights-to-flag victory at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, yet Max Verstappen's late charge left a tiny winning margin that ranks among Formula 1's closest finishes.
detailZh: F1 历史上十大最接近的完赛差距：拉塞尔在巴库顶住了维斯塔潘末段的猛烈追击
随着拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上仅以 0.196 秒的优势压过维斯塔潘冲线，我们一起来回顾 F1 历史上十大最接近的完赛差距
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队
对于观看阿塞拜疆大奖赛的观众来说，很多人都会认同，拉塞尔上演了一场统治级的驾驶，从发车到冲线一路领跑，拿下了 F1 的胜利，击败了红牛车队的维斯塔潘。
然而，当51圈巴库城市赛道比赛结束、方格旗挥动时，两人之间的差距如此之小，"统治"这个词并不常被用来形容。四届冠军维斯塔潘在两次安全车出动后发起 末段进攻，末段进攻，最终只落后梅赛德斯车手0.196秒。
这一差距使今年的阿塞拜疆大奖赛成为一级方程式历史上第11接近的比赛终点差距，让我们来看看排名前十的那些比赛。
10. 2002年奥地利站——迈克尔·舒马赫与鲁本斯·巴里切罗——0.182秒
迈克尔·舒马赫驾驶法拉利F2002，服从车队指令，超越了队友鲁本斯·巴里切罗的法拉利F2002
这份榜单以一个充满争议的结局开场。
当时在奥地利的A1赛道，法拉利队友鲁本斯·巴里切罗和迈克尔·舒马赫正为车队占据前二名，这位巴西车手即将赢得自己该赛季的首场胜利——尽管那个赛季已被他这位四届世界冠军的德国队友所主导。
但在出最后一个弯时，巴里切罗减速，让舒马赫在冲过终点线前超越，令所有观看比赛的人大为失望。这一事件导致车队和两名车手均被罚款，而下个赛季车队指令被明令禁止。
9. 2023年澳大利亚站 - 马克斯·维斯塔潘与刘易斯·汉密尔顿 - 0.179秒
安全车：马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队 小红牛19；刘易斯·汉密尔顿，梅赛德斯 F1 W14；费尔南多·阿隆索，阿斯顿·马丁 AMR23。
2023赛季第三轮比赛扣人心弦，马克斯·维斯塔潘最终取胜，尽管比赛实际上因安全车阶段而提前失去了悬念。
这场比赛三次出示红旗——其中两次是在最后三圈内，分别因为重新起步时发生的连环相撞——最终比赛在安全车领跑下结束，并在最后一圈发出了如今已成惯例的以安全车结束比赛的通告，让维斯塔潘毫无压力地冲过终点线。
得益于安全车把所有赛车聚拢在一起，前两名之间的差距仅为0.179秒。
8. 2000年加拿大大奖赛——迈克尔·舒马赫与鲁本斯·巴里切罗——0.174秒
领奖台：冠军迈克尔·舒马赫，亚军鲁本斯·巴里切罗，法拉利车队，季军吉安卡洛·费斯切拉，贝纳通车队
回到2000年代初的法拉利搭档组合，这一组合在榜单上排名第八，这次是2000年在蒙特利尔举行的加拿大大奖赛。
车队指令再次出现，但没有像2002赛季那样引发争议。一场受雨水影响的比赛中，舒马赫从头领跑，但由于他的法拉利赛车状况不佳，巴里切罗在比赛后半段开始逐渐逼近。
他被要求放慢速度并保持位置，因为舒马赫当时正与迈凯伦的哈基宁争夺总冠军，巴里切罗随即照做，一直咬在队友身后，最终以0.174秒之差冲线。
7. 1961年法国大奖赛 - 吉安卡洛·巴盖蒂与丹·格尼 - 0.100秒
吉安卡洛·巴盖蒂，法拉利156；丹·格尼，保时捷718
接下来是一场在兰斯的比赛，这场比赛的有趣之处不仅在于最后第一名与第二名之间的差距。
吉安卡洛·巴杰蒂在他参加的第一场锦标赛正赛中排位第12，但他驾驶由国际汽车运动联合会（FISA）报名的法拉利赛车在车阵中不断攀升，并参与了一场争夺第四名的激烈大战，对手包括最终获得第二名的丹·格尼以及一众车手。
但当菲尔·希尔和斯特林·莫斯以及众多顶尖车手接连遭遇各种问题而退赛时——其中包括希尔和他的法拉利队友沃尔夫冈·冯·特里普斯以及里奇·金瑟——巴杰蒂只能独自抵挡格尼的保时捷，与之一路缠斗到终点。
巴杰蒂仅以0.100秒的优势获胜，成为第三位在锦标赛首秀中就夺冠的车手。
6. 1954年法国大奖赛——胡安·曼努埃尔·范吉奥与卡尔·克林——0.100秒
汉斯·赫尔曼、胡安·曼努埃尔·范吉奥和卡尔·克林，梅赛德斯
又是法国，这一次时间早了七年，但完赛差距同样是0.100秒。
梅赛德斯的强势回归在兰斯取得了压倒性战绩，胡安·曼努埃尔·范吉奥从杆位发车夺冠，仅以微弱优势挡住了队友卡尔·克林。
如果汉斯·赫尔曼没有退赛，这几乎肯定将是一次一二三名完赛——这位德国车手曾做出全场最快圈速。罗贝尔·曼宗驾驶一辆私人车队的法拉利获得第三名，尽管比前两名慢了整整一圈。
5. 1969年意大利大奖赛——杰基·斯图尔特对阵约亨·林特——差距0.080秒
杰基·斯图尔特驾驶马特拉MS80率先冲线，以微弱优势险胜驾驶路特斯49B的约亨·林特以及驾驶马特拉MS80的让-皮埃尔·贝尔图瓦斯
蒙扎那条老式尾流追逐大战为F1历史上最接近的前五名冲线贡献了其中两场，1969年，杰基·斯图尔特爵士为马特拉拿下了胜利。
斯图尔特用时一小时39分钟跑完这场68圈的比赛，仅比路特斯车手约亨·林特快0.080秒。
但让这一完赛结果更加不同寻常的是，前四名之间的差距本身就小到足以在这篇文章中值得一提——马特拉车队的让-皮埃尔·贝尔图瓦兹以及驾驶自己赛车的布鲁斯·麦克拉伦，与冠军的差距都在0.190秒之内。
4. 1982年奥地利大奖赛——埃利奥·德·安杰利斯与科克·罗斯伯格——0.050秒
领奖台： Lotus Ford 车队的冠军埃利奥·德·安杰利斯，受到获得第二名的 威廉姆斯 车手科克·罗斯伯格的祝贺
在1982年奥地利大奖赛上，原本看似阿兰·普罗斯特十拿九稳的胜利，最终演变成了两位此前从未在F1中夺冠的车手之间的激烈争夺。
detailEn: F1's top 10 closest finishes after George Russell holds off Max Verstappen's late Baku challenge
With George Russell leading Max Verstappen by just 0.196s over the line at the Azerbaijan GP, we take a look at the 10 closest finishes in F1 history
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
For those watching the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, many would agree that George Russell delivered a dominant drive to take a lights-to-flag Formula 1 victory from Red Bull's Max Verstappen.

Yet dominance isn't a word often used when the margin of victory is as small as the gap separating the duo when the chequered flag flew at the end of 51 laps of the Baku City Circuit, four-time champion Verstappen just 0.196s down on the Mercedes driver having launched a late attack following two safety car interventions.
With that gap ensuring this year's Azerbaijan GP ranks as the 11th-closest race finish in Formula 1 history, let's take a look at the events that make up the top 10.
10. Austria 2002 - Michael Schumacher and Rubens Barrichello - 0.182s
Michael Schumacher, Ferrari F2002, follows team orders and takes over team-mate Rubens Barrichello, Ferrari F2002
A controversial finish to begin the list.

Ferrari team-mates Rubens Barrichello and Michael Schumacher were holding a 1-2 for the Scuderia at what was then the A1 Ring in Austria, the Brazilian on course for his first win of a season already dominated by his then-four-time champion German counterpart.

But coming out of the final corner, Barrichello slowed and allowed Schumacher past across the line to the dismay of those watching on. The incident led to a fine for the team and both drivers, while team orders were banned for the following season.
9. Australia 2023 - Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton - 0.179s
The Safety Car Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing RB19, Lewis Hamilton, Mercedes F1 W14, Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin AMR23
A dramatic third round of the 2023 season saw Max Verstappen emerge victorious, albeit with the race effectively ended by a safety car period.

A race thrice red-flagged - twice within the final three laps for separate restart carambolages - ended in neutralisation and the now-traditional end of safety car notice being issued on the final lap, allowing Verstappen to coast over the line untroubled.
Aided by the field being bunched by the safety car, the gap between the top two was just 0.179s.
8. Canada 2000 - Michael Schumacher and Rubens Barrichello - 0.174s
Podium: race winner Michael Schumacher, second place Rubens Barrichello, Ferrari, third place Giancarlo Fisichella, Benetton
Back to the early 2000s Ferrari partnership for eighth on the list and this time the 2000 Canadian Grand Prix in Montreal.

Team orders were again present but not in the controversial fashion that would affect the 2002 campaign. A rain-affected race saw Schumacher lead from the front but in an ailing Ferrari, Barrichello began to close in during the latter stages of the event.

He was instructed to slow and maintain position, with Schumacher in the midst of a title battle with McLaren's Mika Hakkinen, and Barrichello duly obliged, ranging up to the back of his team-mate and finishing 0.174s behind.
7. France 1961 - Giancarlo Baghetti and Dan Gurney - 0.100s
Giancarlo Baghetti, Ferrari 156, Dan Gurney, Porsche 718
A trip to Reims next and a race with an interesting result beyond just the gap between first and second at the end.

Giancarlo Baghetti had qualified 12th in his very first championship race but used his FISA-entered Ferrari to climb through the field, enjoying a gargantuan battle for fourth involving eventual second Dan Gurney and a host of other drivers.

But when Phil Hill and Stirling Moss succumbed among a myriad of issues for the top drivers - including Hill and his Ferrari team-mates Wolfgang Von Trips and Richie Ginther - Baghetti was left to fend of Gurney's Porsche in a battle to the finish.
Baghetti won by just 0.100s, becoming just the third driver to win on his championship debut.
6. France 1954 - Juan Manuel Fangio and Karl Kling - 0.100s
Hans Herrmann, Juan Manuel Fangio and Karl Kling, Mercedes
France again, this time seven years earlier, yet the finishing gap was identical at 0.100s.
A resounding return for Mercedes saw a dominant result in Reims, with Juan Manuel Fangio taking victory from pole, just holding off team-mate Karl Kling.

It almost certainly would have been a 1-2-3 had Hans Herrmann not retired - the German having set the race's fastest lap. Robert Manzon was third in a privateer Ferrari, albeit a lap down on the top two.
5. Italy 1969 - Jackie Stewart and Jochen Rindt - 0.080s
Jackie Stewart, Matra MS80 takes the flag to win just ahead of Jochen Rindt, Lotus 49B, and Jean-Pierre Beltoise, Matra MS80
The old-school slipstream festival at Monza provided two of the top-five closest finishes in F1 history and in 1969, the win was claimed by Sir Jackie Stewart for Matra.
Stewart finished the 68-lap race in an hour and 39 minutes, just 0.080s ahead of Lotus driver Jochen Rindt.

But what makes this finish even more extraordinary is the fact that the gap between the top four would have been close enough to warrant a mention in this article alone - Matra's Jean-Pierre Beltoise and Bruce McLaren in his own car finishing within 0.190s of the victor.
4. Austria 1982 - Elio de Angelis and Keke Rosberg - 0.050s
Podium: race winner Elio de Angelis, Lotus Ford congratulated by Keke Rosberg, Williams, 2nd position
What had looked like a certain victory for Alain Prost resulted in a fierce battle between two drivers who had never won in F1 previously at the 1982 Austrian GP.
keyPointsZh: 巴库城市赛道共51圈，维斯塔潘冲线时紧随拉塞尔之后，双方差距极小
维斯塔潘是四届世界冠军，效力于红牛
keyPointsEn: The race ran 51 laps of the Baku City Circuit, with Verstappen finishing right behind Russell

items.titleZh: 维伦纽夫批评皮亚斯特里阿塞拜疆大奖赛失误："新秀式错误"
items.summaryZh: 1997年F1冠军雅克·维伦纽夫批评奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中的锁死刹车失误是"新秀式错误"。皮亚斯特里在巴库城市赛道守卫位置时发生双重锁死，冲出赛道错失领奖台。

media.altZh: 维伦纽夫批评皮亚斯特里阿塞拜疆大奖赛失误："新秀式错误"

items.originalTitle: Jacques Villeneuve calls out Oscar Piastri after costly Azerbaijan GP error: "Rookie mistake"
items.summaryEn: 1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve called Oscar Piastri's Azerbaijan Grand Prix lock-up a "rookie mistake". Piastri suffered a double lock-up while defending at the Baku City Circuit, which cost him a potential podium finish.
detailZh: 雅克·维伦纽夫在奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里于阿塞拜疆大奖赛犯下代价惨重的失误后公开批评他：“这是新手才会犯的错误”
雅克·维伦纽夫批评奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上的锁轮是一次“新手才会犯的错误”
1997年一级方程式世界冠军雅克·维伦纽夫将奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上的锁轮称为“新手才会犯的错误”。
这位澳大利亚车手在巴库城市赛道的比赛中处于第三名时遭遇了双重锁轮。在主直道上防守红牛车队的伊萨克·哈贾尔时，皮亚斯特里刹车锁死，冲进了缓冲区。这一事故使他失去了登上领奖台的机会，最终只能在第15位挣扎。
皮亚斯特里最终以第14名完赛，而他的队友兰多·诺里斯在与阿尔派车手弗朗哥·科拉平托和皮埃尔·加斯利发生碰撞后退出了比赛。
“这是一个新手错误，”维伦纽夫在天空体育F1直播中分析这一时刻时说，“他被分散了注意力，一直看着后视镜，结果完全错过了刹车点。
“这是实话。失误难免会发生。你可能推得太狠，但可以看到他一直在看后视镜，结果完全错过了刹车点。”
曾三次夺得女子系列赛（W Series）冠军的杰米·查德威克与维伦纽夫一同参与了解说，她分享了自己对迈凯伦这场比赛的看法。“我之前听了他的车队无线电，”查德威克谈到皮亚斯特里时解释道，“两位迈凯伦车手都一直在抱怨很难从赛车上发挥出最佳性能。兰多在整个单圈过程中会得到大量指导，比如他可以在哪里提升、在哪里找到性能。”
她补充道：“归根结底，你划一条界线，这就是一次失误。连奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里也需要审视一下，但从这样的车手身上看到双重锁死是很罕见的。不过在我看来，这事儿有点奇怪。”
皮亚斯特里解释说，这次锁死让他措手不及。“是的，我需要回去看看，因为这件事确实让我很意外。我并不觉得自己刹车刹得太晚或者太重。前轮就是瞬间双双锁死了，所以我显然需要查一查原因，”这位迈凯伦车手对天空体育F1表示。
“这只是令人失望的一天收尾。我觉得比赛的上半程非常强势，所以没错，最后却一无所获，确实很遗憾。”"
detailEn: Jacques Villeneuve calls out Oscar Piastri after costly Azerbaijan GP error: "Rookie mistake"
Jacques Villeneuve criticised Oscar Piastri’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix lock-up as a “rookie mistake”
1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve branded Oscar Piastri's Azerbaijan Grand Prix lock-up as a "rookie mistake".

The Australian driver suffered a double lock-up during the race at the Baku City Circuit while he was running third. Defending from Red Bull's Isack Hadjar down the main straight, Piastri locked the brakes and went wide into the run-off area. The incident took him out of podium contention and left him fighting in 15th place.
Piastri ultimately finished the race in 14th, and his team-mate Lando Norris crashed out after contact with the Alpine drivers, Franco Colapinto and Pierre Gasly.
"It was a rookie mistake," Villeneuve said while analysing the moment during the Sky Sports F1 broadcast. "He got caught out, looking in his mirrors, and just completely missed.
"It's the truth. Mistakes happen. You push too hard, but then you can see he was looking in his mirrors and just completely missed."

Three-time W Series champion Jamie Chadwick, who joined Villeneuve on the broadcast, shared her view of McLaren's race. "I had his radio on before," Chadwick explained of Piastri. "There was a lot of complaining generally from both McLaren drivers about struggling to get the best out of their car. Lando gets coached quite a lot throughout the lap in terms of where he can improve, where he can find performance."

She added: "At the end of the day, you draw a line, and it's a mistake. Even Oscar Piastri needs to look at it, but it's rare that you see a double lock-up like that from a driver like that. It seemed odd to me, though."

Piastri explained that the lock-up took him by surprise. "Yeah, I need to go and look because it certainly took me by surprise. I didn't think I braked super late or super hard. Just instantly locked both fronts, so I need to obviously look at that," the McLaren driver told Sky Sports F1.
"Just a disappointing end to the day. I think the first half of the race was very strong, so yeah, a shame to not have anything to show for it."
keyPointsZh: 皮亚斯特里当时正排在第三位，在主直道上防守红牛车队伊萨克·哈贾尔时发生刹车锁死，冲入缓冲区。
这次事故使他失去争夺领奖台的机会，最终掉到第15位作战。
keyPointsEn: Piastri was running third and locked up while defending from Red Bull's Isack Hadjar down the main straight, going wide into the run-off area.
The incident took him out of podium contention and left him fighting in 15th place.

items.titleZh: 瓦塞尔抱怨法拉利被换帅传闻干扰，提及霍纳求职话题
items.summaryZh: 法拉利领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔表示，围绕他去留的无休止猜测正在干扰他和车队，并承认其中就包括霍纳寻找工作一事。他还强调2026年赛车动力单元的劣势是本周末巴库站两车只取得第四和第六的主因。
items.originalTitle: 'Mr Horner looking for a job' - Vasseur laments Ferrari distractions
items.summaryEn: Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur says he and his team are being undermined by relentless speculation about his future, acknowledging "Mr Horner looking for a job" as part of it. He also stressed that the 2026 power unit deficit was the main factor in his cars finishing fourth and sixth in Baku.
detailZh: 法拉利一级方程式车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔表示，关于他未来的无休止猜测正在削弱他和车队的士气——他也承认“霍纳先生正在找工作”是这些猜测的一部分。
瓦塞尔于2023年接替比诺托执掌法拉利车队，但和前任时期一样，法拉利仍然无法真正跻身一级方程式的争冠行列。
2026年，一辆潜在的全场最佳底盘因为动力单元的劣势而被削弱，瓦塞尔再次强调，这正是本周末在巴库车队两辆赛车分别获得第四名和第六名的主要原因。
这场比赛的背景是前红牛老板克里斯蒂安·霍纳最近接受《泰晤士报》的一次采访，霍纳在采访中声称，就再次执掌一支一级方程式车队而言，“只有一支车队会让我愿意接受不参与所有权”。
那支车队被暗示是法拉利，霍纳将其形容为“梦想”的目的地，并且“可以说是F1沉睡的巨人”。
当《The Race》在阿塞拜疆大奖赛后被问及围绕他本人前途以及法拉利F1车队领导层计划的传闻时，瓦塞尔短暂地摆脱了他一贯的玩笑和回避语气，明确表示他不喜欢这种局面。
“啊，我们现在无法在完全的平静中工作，”他坚称。“首先是对我而言，也是对车队里的每一个人。对媒体来说，50%的问题都是关于这件事的，我认为这有点让人沮丧。”
“我们正在为年度车队亚军而战，可到了最后，大家都在不停地谈论这件事，甚至对维修区里的技师们来说，谈论的也是这个话题，这是我们唯一能谈的最好的话题了。
"但事情就是这样，这不在我手里。霍纳先生正在找工作——大家都知道——到处都在找。
"但我能做什么呢？只能尽力去推动车队，激励他们保持斗志，专注于当下最好的事情。
"每次采访，一天25次，我们都会回到这个话题上。"
瓦塞尔也表达了他对法拉利的承诺，以及对"这份世界上最好的工作"的坚持——但他还奇怪地补充道："但事情就是这样。我们还有七场比赛要跑，我会坚持到最后一个弯角。"
当被问到是否愿意在法拉利与霍纳共事时，他开玩笑说："这个你得问我的助手。"
detailEn: Ferrari Formula 1 team principal Fred Vasseur says he and his team are being undermined by relentless speculation over his future - and acknowledges "Mr [Christian] Horner looking for a job" as part of this.
Vasseur took over from Mattia Binotto at the helm of the Ferrari squad in 2023, but - like under his predecessor - Ferrari still has not been able to break through into genuine F1 title contention.

In 2026, a potential grid-best chassis has been neutered by a power unit deficit, which Vasseur again accentuated as the primary factor in his team's cars finishing fourth and sixth this weekend in Baku.

The race took place against the backdrop of a recent interview with The Times by ex-Red Bull boss Christian Horner, in which Horner claimed that, in terms of running an F1 team again, there was "only one team for which I would accept non-participation in ownership".
That team was implied to be Ferrari, which Horner described as "the dream" destination and "arguably the sleeping giant of F1".

When asked by The Race after the Azerbaijan GP about the noise surrounding his own future and Ferrari's F1 team leadership plans, Vasseur briefly pivoted from his usual jokey-and-deflective tone to make it clear he doesn't appreciate the situation.

"Ah, we are not working in the perfect serenity," he insisted. "For me firstly, but for everybody in the team. For the media, for 50% of the questions [to be] about this, I think it's a bit of a frustrating situation.

"We are fighting for P2 in the championship, and at the end of the day, we are all speaking a lot about this, and even for the guys in the garage, to discuss about this, it's the best discussion that we can have.
"But it is what it is, it's not in my hands. Mr Horner is looking for a job - that everybody knows - everywhere.
"But what can I do? Just try to do my best to push the team, to rise them to be motivated, focus on what is better today.
"Each interview, 25 times a day, we are coming back to this."

Vasseur also affirmed his commitment to Ferrari and "the best job in the world" - but also curiously added: "But it is like it is. We have still seven races to go, and I will push until the last corner."
On whether he would be open to working with Horner within Ferrari, he joked: "You have to ask my assistant."
keyPointsZh: 瓦塞尔自2023年起接替比诺托执掌法拉利，但车队至今未能真正进入争冠行列。
2026年赛车底盘潜力被视为围场最佳，却被动力单元劣势所拖累。
霍纳此前接受《泰晤士报》采访时暗示只愿为一支不要求他放弃所有权的车队工作，即他称为"沉睡巨人"的法拉利。
keyPointsEn: Vasseur took over from Mattia Binotto at Ferrari in 2023, but the team has still not broken through into genuine title contention.
In 2026, a potentially grid-best chassis has been neutered by a power unit deficit.
Horner told The Times there was "only one team for which I would accept non-participation in ownership", implying Ferrari, which he called the "sleeping giant of F1".

items.originalTitle: Jacques Villeneuve defends Red Bull team orders call at F1 Azerbaijan GP
items.summaryEn: 1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve has backed Red Bull's decision not to swap Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: 雅克·维伦纽夫为红牛在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上的车队指令决定进行辩护
雅克·维伦纽夫支持红牛在阿塞拜疆大奖赛期间不交换马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔位置的决定
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
1997年F1世界冠军雅克·维伦纽夫支持红牛在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上的策略。
在充满挑战的巴库城市赛道上，比赛进入尾声阶段时，马克斯·维斯塔潘与队友伊萨克·哈贾尔前后紧随行驶。
尽管哈贾尔拥有轮胎优势，但这支位于米尔顿凯恩斯的车队并没有指示这位四届世界冠军让出赛道位置，以便让这位法国裔阿尔及利亚车手向前方赛车发起进攻。
维斯塔潘在最后几圈成功拉开差距，向比赛冠军乔治·拉塞尔发起挑战。维斯塔潘最终以第二名完赛，仅落后这位梅赛德斯车手0.196秒。哈贾尔此前因手腕伤病缺席了六周，最终获得第三名。
在接受天空体育一级方程式节目采访时，维伦纽夫驳斥了红牛应该交换车手位置的说法，并称赞了这支由洛朗·梅基斯领导的车队对比赛的解读。
“那非常完美，”这位加拿大车手说。“没有任何理由让马克斯给伊萨克让车。
哈贾尔当时用的是更好的轮胎，而且圈速和马克斯很接近。所以在某个时间点他们本来会交换轮胎，而正如我们所看到的，马克斯在最后几圈把差距拉大到了对哈贾尔的八秒。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队；伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
“马克斯冲到最前面的机会更大，所以他们做的是正确的。”
梅基斯确认，车队确实考虑过车队指令方面的各种选择。
“说实话，我们研究了所有这些情况，然后我们选择让赛车保持在当时的位置上，”这位车队负责人告诉天空体育F1。
“两位车手在保持纪律方面都做得非常好。也要大大地夸一夸伊萨克，他跑得非常聪明，确保我们拿到了最好的团队成绩。”
“我们觉得这是争取超过皮亚斯特里和拉塞尔的最好机会。在这里，很难不去指望某一时刻会出现安全车。我们都在等待安全车。”
"马克斯在那个阶段用中性胎很挣扎，而我们知道用软胎会有更好的机会。最终，事情正是这样发展的。"
"我们差了0.1秒，但我们获得了与他战斗的机会，并且展现出了与他相同的节奏。"
detailEn: Jacques Villeneuve defends Red Bull team orders call at F1 Azerbaijan GP
Jacques Villeneuve has backed Red Bull's decision not to swap Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve has backed Red Bull's Azerbaijan Grand Prix strategy.
During the closing stages of the race on the demanding Baku City Circuit, Max Verstappen and team-mate Isack Hadjar were running one behind the other.
Although Hadjar had a tyre advantage, the Milton Keynes outfit chose not to instruct the four-time champion to yield track position to allow the French-Algerian driver to attack the cars ahead.

Verstappen managed to pull away in the final laps to mount a challenge to race winner George Russell. Verstappen ultimately finished second, just 0.196 seconds behind the Mercedes driver. Hadjar, who had been out with a wrist injury for six weeks, finished third.
Speaking on the Sky Sports F1 broadcast, Villeneuve dismissed suggestions that Red Bull should have swapped its drivers, praising the Laurent Mekies-led team's reading of the race.
"It was perfect," the Canadian said. "There was no reason to ask Max to let Isack by.
"Hadjar was on the better tyre and the lap time was similar to Max. So at one point they would swap over the tyre and, as we've seen, Max built an eight-second gap on Hadjar [in the final laps].
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
"Max had a better chance of getting to the front so they did the right thing."
Mekies confirmed the team did consider its options regarding team orders.
"We looked at all these scenarios, honestly, and then we elected to hold the car in those positions," the team chief told Sky Sports F1.
"Both drivers have been very good at being disciplined with that. Big well done also to Isack who has raced very cleverly to make sure we get the best team result.
"We felt it was the best chance to get a chance at Piastri and at Russell. It's very difficult here not to count on a safety car at some stage. We were all waiting for the safety car.
"Max was struggling with the medium at that stage and we knew that on the soft we would have a better chance. Ultimately, that's what happened.
"We are missing one tenth but we got a chance to fight with him and show we had the same pace."
keyPointsZh: 比赛尾声在巴库城市赛道，维斯塔潘与队友伊萨克·哈德前后行驶，哈德虽拥有轮胎优势，红牛仍选择不互换位置
keyPointsEn: During the closing stages on the Baku City Circuit, Verstappen and Isack Hadjar ran one behind the other, and despite Hadjar's tyre advantage, Red Bull chose not to instruct the four-time champion to yield track position.
